verdict.rationale: HubSpot can be driven without its UI. There are documented REST APIs (e.g. `POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts`, batch custom-object retrieval), a webhooks journal API for event-driven automation, and a globally installable npm CLI (`npm install -g @hubspot/cli && hs init`). Date-versioned APIs and up to 10 test accounts also support stable automated pipelines that don't touch real data. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, evidence of non-interactive or token-based CLI authentication for headless runners (the docs only show an 'Authorize your HubSpot account' step), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
